title: Aspen Search practice areas
description: A huge three-line all-caps heading (middle line pushed to the right edge) on a grey tile with a small paragraph and mono button in its bottom-right corner, beside a dark column of practice rows: mono index, a 38px title, a short paragraph, a square line-art slot and a mono capital list with mint square bullets. Heading lines rise far out of their clips as they enter view; copy rises line by line.
notes: each row's media slot is a 176px square; empty it's a dashed hairline placeholder
the heading tile is grey on desktop and plain paper on phones, as on the original
CSS only; reveals are off under reduced motion
